concepts.name: the gate on a release
concepts.formula: promote(candidate) ⇔ m(candidate) > m(approved) + δ, with δ = 0 here (a tie is refused) and δ = 0.01 in Module 5
concepts.citation: Zaharia, Chen, Davidson, Ghodsi, Hong, Konwinski, Murching, Nykodym, Ogilvie, Parkhe, Xie & Zumar (2018)

concepts.name: release by indirection, and rollback as the same move reversed
concepts.formula: serve(name) = artefact[approved]; promote: approved ← candidate, history ← history + [candidate]; rollback: history ← history[:−1], approved ← history[−1]
concepts.citation: Zaharia, Chen, Davidson, Ghodsi, Hong, Konwinski, Murching, Nykodym, Ogilvie, Parkhe, Xie & Zumar (2018)

concepts.name: the model signature recorded with the artefact
concepts.formula: S = (name_i, type_i)_{i=1..k}, recorded with the model; accept(x) ⇔ ∀i: name_i ∈ columns(x) ∧ type(x[name_i]) = type_i; input = (x[name_1], …, x[name_k])
concepts.citation: Zaharia, Chen, Davidson, Ghodsi, Hong, Konwinski, Murching, Nykodym, Ogilvie, Parkhe, Xie & Zumar (2018)

concepts.name: release by alias
concepts.formula: alias: name@alias → version; promote: alias[champion] ← version; rollback: alias[champion] ← previous version; serve(models:/name@champion)
concepts.citation: Zaharia, Chen, Davidson, Ghodsi, Hong, Konwinski, Murching, Nykodym, Ogilvie, Parkhe, Xie & Zumar (2018)

concepts.name: the promotion verdict, and the argument for it
concepts.formula: verdict(evidence) = (call, reason), call ∈ {promote, hold, roll back}; roll back ⇔ m(approved, now) < m(approved, at promotion) − δ_r; promote ⇔ ¬roll back ∧ K(candidate) < K(approved) ∧ K(candidate) < K(trivial) ∧ p95(candidate) ≤ budget; otherwise hold

concepts.name: the data contract at the door
concepts.slide: Definition — the data contract at the door
concepts.formula: accept(x) ⇔ ∀f: (required_f ⇒ f ∈ x) ∧ (f ∈ x ∧ x[f] = null ⇒ nullable_f) ∧ (f ∈ x ∧ x[f] ≠ null ⇒ type(x[f]) = type_f ∧ min_f ≤ x[f] ≤ max_f); otherwise the refusal names every f that failed

concepts.name: refusal at the door, and provenance in the answer
concepts.slide: Definition — refusal at the door, and provenance in the answer
concepts.formula: complaints ≠ ∅ ⇒ (status 422, every complaint naming its field, model calls = 0); complaints = ∅ ⇒ (status 200, probability p, decision = aboard iff p ≥ t, model_version, threshold t)

concepts.name: the cost-sensitive decision threshold
concepts.formula: t* = C_fp / (C_fp + C_fn); decide aboard ⇔ p ≥ t*

concepts.name: the realised cost of a threshold
concepts.slide: Definition — realised cost of a threshold
concepts.formula: K(t) = C_fp · #{i : p_i ≥ t and y_i = 0} + C_fn · #{i : p_i < t and y_i = 1}

concepts.name: reliability in bands, and the largest gap
concepts.slide: Definition — reliability in bands, and the largest gap
concepts.formula: B_j = {i : e_j ≤ p_i < e_(j+1)}, the last band closed at the top; predicted_j = mean_{i ∈ B_j} p_i, actual_j = mean_{i ∈ B_j} y_i, kept when |B_j| ≥ r; largest gap = max_j |predicted_j − actual_j|

concepts.name: cost at the mean demand against mean cost over the demand
concepts.slide: Definition — cost at the mean versus mean cost
concepts.formula: g(E[D]) = C_fn · max(0, E[D] − c) and E[g(D)] = C_fn · Σ_{d>c} (d − c) · P(D = d), with D ~ Poisson(λ)

concepts.name: training-serving skew, caused on purpose and measured
concepts.slide: Definition — causing the skew, and measuring it
concepts.formula: changed(π) = |{i : 1[p_i ≥ t] ≠ 1[p_i^π ≥ t]}| / n, where p_i^π is the same request with two declared fields exchanged and the row assembled in the order the keys arrived; failures(π) = 0; and re-assembling in the stored order gives changed = 0

concepts.name: training-serving skew, and the cure by stored order
concepts.formula: skew ⇔ prepare_serve(x) ≠ prepare_train(x); cure: input_j = ((x[f_j] if present else median_{f_j}) − mean_{f_j}) / std_{f_j} for f_j in the stored order, j = 1..k

concepts.name: percentile latency by nearest rank
concepts.formula: Q(p) = x_(⌈p · n / 100⌉), where x_(1) ≤ … ≤ x_(n) are the sorted durations

concepts.name: one preparation, two paths
concepts.formula: batch(frame)_i = model(prepare(row_i)) for every row i, |difference| < 10⁻⁹

concepts.name: the model signature, enforced at prediction
concepts.formula: S = (name_i, type_i)_{i=1..k}, recorded with the model; accept(x) ⇔ ∀i: name_i ∈ columns(x) ∧ type(x[name_i]) = type_i; input = (x[name_1], …, x[name_k])
concepts.citation: Zaharia, Chen, Davidson, Ghodsi, Hong, Konwinski, Murching, Nykodym, Ogilvie, Parkhe, Xie & Zumar (2018)
